name: Young Elspeth
description: The child version of Elspeth in the dungeon memory, who speaks with a voice without youth and is revealed to be Elspeth herself.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes inside a memory in her childhood dungeon and kills a Phyrexian-like beast to save the girl, her younger self, standing over her slain mother.
timeline.quote: This time, she does what the girl could only dream of doing. This time, she has a sword.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The girl speaks with an adult voice and warns that a splicer is coming; Elspeth realizes the girl is her younger self and is told to wake up.
